# PixSpell

> Every asset for a 2D game, from code: a zero-dependency JavaScript library and CC0 collection that generates characters (2.7 million combinations of bodies, hats and held items, with 8-direction walk cycles and attack/hit/heal/level-up/cast/death animations in 5 elements), pixel-art sprites (items, tiles, monsters, icons), 600+ procedural effects that glow (110 designs, any color, any size), 103 sound effects and 17 chiptune music tracks, with exports for Phaser/Aseprite and Godot at an 8, 16, 32 or 64 px tile grid. Sprites are text art painted with color ramps, so everything can be recolored, combined and resized in one call. An AI coding agent can build a complete-looking game with it alone (see the Spell Survivors example).

Import in a browser with no install: `import { spell } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/olebangpad/pixspell@main/src/index.js'`.
Art is CC0 (public domain); code is MIT.

## Docs

- [Skill / quick reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/skills/pixspell/SKILL.md): setup, rules for crisp pixel art, the whole API, recipes for a playable game and for engine exports
- [Sprite catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/skills/pixspell/catalog.md): every sprite id, its size, frames and variants
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/README.md): overview and showcase
- Check assets by eye before using them: `npx pixspell preview <names or calls> -o preview.png` renders every frame into one image; `npx -y pixspell mcp` is an MCP server whose `preview` tool returns that image

## Examples

- [Canvas starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/templates/canvas/index.html): a one-file top-down game, no build step
- [Phaser starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/templates/phaser/index.html): PixSpell game packs loaded with load.aseprite
- [Spell Survivors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/examples/spell-survivors/index.html): a complete survivor-style game in one HTML file, every asset from PixSpell, written by an AI agent
- [Demo game source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/pixspell/main/web/quest.js): collisions, enemies, pickups, HUD
- [Playable demo](https://olebangpad.github.io/pixspell/game.html), [character maker](https://olebangpad.github.io/pixspell/#maker), [effects gallery](https://olebangpad.github.io/pixspell/fx.html) and [sounds](https://olebangpad.github.io/pixspell/sfx.html)
